provenance.buildNote: Single-binary WASI build (bedtools self-multiplexes on argv[1]) via build/bedtools/Dockerfile + build.sh, wasi-sdk 33, single-threaded. Built with the WASM exception-handling proposal (-fwasm-exceptions; bedtools throws/catches on normal paths — same recipe as kit/z3), so the runtime must enable WASM-EH (Foundation's wasi runtime already hosts z3). Bundled htslib 1.9 built zlib-only (bz2/lzma/libcurl disabled; knetfile/hfile_net network backend stripped — no sockets in WASI); zlib 1.3.1 cross-compiled from source. Exposed surface is single-input stdin ops only (merge, sort): Foundation's wasi runtime supplies one stdin and preopens only /tmp, so two-input ops (intersect -a/-b, subtract, closest) cannot run under today's contract — they are compiled into the binary but NOT exposed (see instruction.md, 'requires multi-file runtime contract').
